caption: The drawing consists of two line sketches of a bodice or corset on a plain, beige background. The larger sketch occupies the lower central part of the image and shows the front view of a corset with short sleeves, a wide neckline, and vertical seaming or boning lines along the torso. The garment tapers at the waist and flares slightly at the hips. Above and to the right of this main drawing is a smaller sketch that shows the back view of the same garment, displaying lacing that closes the corset, with similar short sleeves and a flared lower edge. Both sketches are rendered using fine, light blue or graphite lines with minimal shading or color variation. There are no other objects or elements present in the composition.
title: Corset
